label: Evaluation of immunoreactive epitopes in the sera and cerebrospinal fluid of patients with post-treatment Lyme disease syndrome.
summary: While most patients fully recover after treatment for Lyme disease with recommended antibiotic regimens, some report non-specific symptoms after treatment. When these symptoms are unexplained by other conditions and persist for ≥ 6 months, this condition is called post-treatment Lyme disease symptoms or syndrome (PTLDS).
